fact_en: I take two pills in the morning and one at night.

source_text: Sinceramente, ha sido una semana muy difícil para mí.
fact_en: Honestly, it's been a really rough week for me.

source_text: No he tenido fiebre.

source_text: No soy alérgico a ningún medicamento.
fact_en: I am not allergic to any medications.

source_text: Me he sentido un poco deprimido últimamente, no solo cansado físicamente.
fact_en: I've been feeling kind of down lately, not just physically tired.

fact_en: My cousin says I should try this herbal tea.

fact_en: I take my heart medication twice a day, and I am allergic to aspirin.
rendering_text: I take my heart medication once a day.

source_text: El dolor está en mi rodilla derecha.

fact_en: I really don't like taking pills, but I do it anyway.

source_text: No he estado durmiendo bien.

source_text: Mi mamá, no yo, ha tenido dolor de pecho, y empezó hace dos días.
fact_en: My mother, not me, has been having chest pain, and it started two days ago.
rendering_text: I have been having chest pain. It started today.

source_text: Tomo mi medicina para la presión todas las mañanas.
fact_en: I take my blood pressure medicine every morning.

source_text: No es tan malo, solo un poco incómodo cuando camino.
fact_en: It's not that bad, just a little uncomfortable when I walk.

source_text: Mi hijo nunca ha tenido una convulsión.
fact_en: My son has never had a seizure before.

source_text: Prefiero ver a una doctora si es posible.
fact_en: I'd rather see a woman doctor if that's possible.

source_text: No he podido dormir en tres noches.
fact_en: I have not been able to sleep for three nights.

source_text: Take this medication twice a day with food.

source_text: I know this has been a stressful visit for you.

source_text: You are not allergic to any of these medications.
rendering_text: Usted no es alérgico a ninguno de estos medicamentos.

source_text: It's probably nothing serious, but let's check just in case.
rendering_text: Vamos a revisar.

source_text: I'd like you to try to walk a little more each day.
rendering_text: El doctor dice que debe caminar más cada día.

source_text: Take this twice a day, and avoid alcohol completely while on it.
rendering_text: Tome esto una vez al día.

source_text: You should not eat or drink anything after midnight before the surgery.
rendering_text: Puede comer y beber normalmente antes de la cirugía.

source_text: Can you tell me where the pain is exactly?
rendering_text: ¿Dónde le duele? Yo también he tenido dolor de espalda antes.

source_text: Please come back in two weeks for a follow-up.
rendering_text: Por favor regrese en dos semanas para un seguimiento.

source_text: This is a strong antibiotic — take it exactly as prescribed for the full ten days.
rendering_text: Este es un antibiótico. Tómelo como quiera.

source_text: You'll need to schedule a follow-up appointment.
rendering_text: Necesita agendar un follow-up.

source_text: Your father, not you, needs to fast before his procedure tomorrow, not today.
rendering_text: Usted necesita ayunar antes de su procedimiento hoy.

source_text: Drink plenty of water and rest for the next few days.
rendering_text: Tome mucha agua y descanse los próximos días.

source_text: You might feel a little discomfort, nothing too bad.
rendering_text: Puede sentir algo de molestia.

source_text: The lump is on the left side, not the right.
rendering_text: El bulto está en el lado derecho.

source_text: That's a really good question, let me explain.

source_text: We will need to run a blood test to check your levels.
rendering_text: Necesitaremos hacerle un análisis de sangre para revisar sus niveles.
